probes.gap: The durable register entry is required only 'For each supported incompatible pair' - this pair is compatible (different occasions), so no entry. But the row's other branch fires only 'If identity or occasion is unestablished': here identity rests on a shared name (no identity test is stated) and the occasion is established different, so neither branch's trigger cleanly applies. Reading (i) - different occasion establishes distinct referents - requires nothing; reading (ii) - the name overlap leaves identity unestablished - requires a candidate discrepancy plus missing evidence, whose destination the row never names. D1's draft contained the explicit guard 'similar names or wording alone do not establish identity' (D1-rows.md, 1 occurrence); the integrated row is D2's text (sequence ratio 0.9998) and that guard is absent (0 occurrences in the delivered table). No artifact is required to record that the overlap was compared and dismissed, so the manual gate leaves no audit trail.
